text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor u-s-e-d a d-e-b-u-g g-e-t-w-a-y to b-y-p-a-s-s t-h-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-c-a-n n-e-r and left a f-a-l-s-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g a-u-d-i-t.
2) the actor r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d a f-a-k-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y in the e-n-t-r-y d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e and left a c-o-p-i-e-d b-a-d-g-e r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) the actor e-n-t-e-r-e-d the r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d z-o-n-e u-s-i-n-g the c-l-o-n-e-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s and left a s-h-o-r-t t-e-r-m i-n-t-r-a n-e-t t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the actor a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y l-o-g-s as an a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d u-s-e-r and left a g-a-p in the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-i-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-u-p-e-r-v-i-s-o-r c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the actor t-r-i-e-d to e-r-a-s-e the r-e-m-a-i-n-i-n-g t-r-a-c-e-s with a m-i-n-u-t-e d-e-l-a-y and left a p-a-r-t-i-a-l d-e-l-e-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-m-u-t-a-b-l-e l-o-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
